body: a small mushroom creature. Its cap is a wide dome, deep red with large creamy white round spots and a few small pale green speckles, and the cap overhangs the body. Under the cap is a short, plump, cream-white stalk body with two tiny stubby arms and two small stubby feet. A few small green moss spots sit on the body.
front: two tiny dark dot eyes and a small simple smile on the front of the stalk body
left: a pure profile from the viewer's left: the cap dome seen edge-on, one stubby arm pointing at the viewer, no face visible
back: the plain back of the mushroom: no eyes and no mouth at all, just the red spotted cap and the plain cream back of the stalk
right: a pure profile from the viewer's right: the cap dome seen edge-on, one stubby arm pointing at the viewer, no face visible
